description: SEC Form 8-K material event filings for a US-listed company, with the 8-K item codes decoded (earnings release, acquisition completed, officer departure, material agreement, delisting notice...). Answers what significant corporate events a company has disclosed and when. Response field matched_by says whether the company was matched by ticker or by company name.

ticker.description: Stock ticker ("AAPL"), company name, or CIK

name: insider_8k

all_matches_considered.description: False when the SEC held more matching documents than this call could read (page cap), so older filings went unexamined

cik.description: SEC CIK the ticker resolved to (unpadded)

description.description: Human-readable description of the event type

filings_considered.description: Unique filings examined before `limit` was applied; `filings` holds the newest of them

matched_8k_filings.description: Number of 8-K filings matching upstream for this company and window, which may exceed the number returned. null when the SEC held more matching documents than the page cap reads (all_matches_considered false): the total is unknown, not zero

matched_by.description: How the company was matched: ticker, cik or company_name

oldest_filing_date_considered.description: Oldest filing date among the filings examined

total_8k_filings.description: Number of 8-K filings RETURNED in `filings`, always equals filings.length

truncated.description: True when more filings matched upstream than were returned; raise `limit` to see them

title: Insider 8k
